Tuesday, June 30: Somerset Patriots defeat Hartford Yard Goats; Manning High School standout Tomas Frick on roster
By
N. S. OliverOn Tuesday, June 30, at 6:35 p.m., the Somerset Patriots — the current team of former Manning High School standout Tomas Frick — defeated the Hartford Yard Goats 5-2 in an MiLB game.
The game was played at TD Bank Ballpark. It was the teams' first meeting this season.
Frick had no hits in three at-bats, scored one run, drew one walk, struck out once and left four runners on base.
The Patriots' next game is scheduled for Wednesday, July 1, at TD Bank Ballpark against the Somerset Patriots.
